name: They Know Them
effect: Swaps nouns and 'you' for the pronouns they/them/their, so text turns vague and slightly paranoid, often opening with 'They say they don't...'. It frequently collapses into loops of the same pronoun phrase ('They know them. They know them..
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
